record_kind: didactic derivation record; not a transformer construction record and not an execution log
provenance: Adapted from the Alpha-v0.1.0-Alkimim example derivations. The four reusable models under models/ were specified for Alpha-v0.2.0-Alkimim and applied to the projects manually; the instances are declared in model-instances.json. No transformer was constructed or executed for this adaptation.

added_decisions.en: Organize the illustrative needs into stable cases, actors, outcomes, and acceptance criteria; keep channel choices out of the specification.
added_decisions.pt-BR: Organizar as necessidades didáticas em casos estáveis, atores, resultados e critérios de aceite; manter escolhas de canal fora da especificação.

source_model.status: external needs record, reconstructed; reusable needs model unspecified
source_model.provenance_limit: Needs baseline reconstructed from the existing UCS; not independent historical stakeholder evidence.

added_decisions.en: Single L1-to-L2 derivation producing both ADMV components: ADPM models ItemKey and Item as data entities, keeps catalog policy in four cases, injects ItemStore and the lookup case, and checks permissions before effects; ADVS plans one behavioral test identity per case with supporting scenario, entity, storage, concurrency, and channel checks, including missing and forbidden actors.
added_decisions.pt-BR: Derivação única L1→L2 produzindo ambos os componentes da ADMV: o ADPM modela ItemKey e Item como entidades de dados, mantém as regras do catálogo nos quatro casos, injeta ItemStore e o caso de consulta e verifica permissões antes dos efeitos; a ADVS planeja uma identidade de teste comportamental por caso com verificações de apoio de cenário, entidade, armazenamento, concorrência e canal, incluindo atores ausentes e sem permissão.

added_decisions.en: Use Python cases, injected SQLite storage, and executable criterion-linked checks.
added_decisions.pt-BR: Usar casos em Python, armazenamento SQLite injetado e verificações executáveis ligadas aos critérios.

added_decisions.en: Expose callable cases through a loopback browser and JSON routes; select HTTP Basic credentials, representations, and status mapping as channel decisions of this boundary.
added_decisions.pt-BR: Expor os casos invocáveis por navegador local e rotas JSON; escolher credenciais HTTP Basic, representações e códigos de resposta como decisões de canal desta fronteira.

stable_revision.kind: compatibility review of manually derived artifacts
stable_revision.accountability: responsible_people names belong to the historical derivations; this preparation asserts no new human approval
